detail.title: 4MP 40x Starlight IR Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD8A440GA-HNV 4MP 40x Starlight IR Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4MP Resolution • 40× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 500m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • 1/1.8" CMOS Sensor Ensures Premium Images • Smart Wipers Automatically Sense Rain to Keep the Lens Clear • Auto Tracking 3.0: Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • Face Detection: Leveraging Facial Data to Enhance Analytics Accuracy • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.001 lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0001 lux@F1.6 0 lux (IR light on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –30° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; bounding box; optimization; capturing pictures; uploading high-quality face snapshots Motor vehicle attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle type, vehicle color, vehicle logo, vehicle model/year, sun visor, seatbelt, smoking, calling, ornament, and annual inspection sticker
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; climbing fences; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification; linkage tracking
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, face bounding box, optimization, capturing snapshots, uploading high-quality face snapshots, and enhancing face images. Attribute extraction is also supported, where 6 attributes and 8 expressions can be detected. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing, quality first, and selecting a preferred image among a group of snapshots
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; H.264B; H.264H; MJPEG (Sub Stream)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 4M/3M/1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF (1–25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H264: 96 Kbps–14,848 Kbps H265: 38 Kbps–8,960 Kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
General.Storage: Micro SD card (512 GB); FTP/SFTP; NAS
General.Browser: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 42 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions Safari 10 and later versions
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; tour; pattern; recording; alarm digital input; audio; send email
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card status detection; memory space detection; power exception detection
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 17 W Max.: 32 W (illuminator + heater + PTZ)
General.Protection: IP67, TVS 8000V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
